published_prior_art.cite: DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2024 reduces discrete causal queries to polynomial programs, but not this exact entropy-constrained response-type fiber.

KumarLiElGamal2014 gives a three-state bound for binary common entropy without factual and cross-world moment preservation; DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2024 gives generic, larger discrete-SCM programs.
KumarLiElGamal2014 defines G(A;Y) as the minimum entropy of an exact product-mixture factorization; the proposed causal completion adds a direct cross-world interpretation.

JiangWeiKocaoglu2023 supplies the mutual-information relaxation and KumarLiElGamal2014 supplies the binary common-entropy computation, but neither gives this causal-origin false-inclusion neighborhood.
TianPearl2000 supplies unrestricted scalar probabilities-of-causation bounds; the joint segment/rectangle sensitivity-path packaging is a modest extension.
JiangWeiKocaoglu2023 studies scalar low-entropy bounds and Peña2023 studies separate benefit/harm bounds, neither the star kernel of this joint exact-entropy set.
ChafaiConcordet2009 proves exact multinomial-region coverage; propagation through a union-valued identified-set map is immediate once that region is available.
DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2024 and ArayaReyes2016 do not certify singular Shannon-entropy causal-image contact strata with witness sections.
JonzonSachsGabriel2023 is polyhedral causaloptim, while generic interval literature does not provide the stated two-sided entropy-causal-image certificate.
ChernozhukovHongTamer2007, FangSantos2019, and MastenPoirier2020 are regular/directionally differentiable identified-set frameworks, orthogonal to support-changing entropy-contact expansions.

soundness_flags.label: def:common-entropy and thm:origin-common-entropy-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: The minimization fixes the previously declared finite alphabet U while the intended common entropy must range over all finite auxiliaries; quantify over finite U explicitly and state the cardinality convention that makes the infimum a minimum.

soundness_flags.label: def:exact-multinomial-region and prop:exact-whole-set-coverage
soundness_flags.one_line: The likelihood is defined on the closed simplex but gives no convention for 0^0 in q_ay^{c_ay}, so the claimed exact coverage is undefined at factual laws with zero cells.

soundness_flags.label: prop:exact-whole-set-coverage
soundness_flags.one_line: Apart from the imported multinomial coverage event, whole-set containment follows immediately by substituting P into the defining union, so this is a supporting corollary rather than an independent result.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v1, 1 February 2014; cited bibliography also supplies this preprint identifier
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Defines G(X;Y)=min_{X→W→Y} H(W), gives |W|≤3 for binary alphabets through Proposition 6, and states that a two-state W suffices in Proposition 8.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 4-5, Theorem 3.2 and Section 4; appendix pp. 11-12
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Assumes H(Z)≤θ and derives scalar causal-effect programs whose entropy restriction is imposed through mutual-information constraints, including I(Rx;Ry)≤H(Z).
Presents automated sharp bounding for discrete causal queries via polynomial programming, dual relaxation, and spatial branch-and-bound.
Studies separate probability-of-benefit and probability-of-harm bounds under unmeasured confounding using sensitivity parameters or a proxy.
Describes causaloptim as a graphical interface for tight symbolic causal bounds based on the pre-existing response-function methodology.
Constructs controlled-coverage multinomial confidence regions through inversion of likelihood-level covering collections.
Develops estimation, rates, and confidence regions for criterion-defined partially identified sets.
Is the published breakdown-frontier inference paper in Quantitative Economics 11, pp. 41-111.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define G_P(A;Y) over all finite auxiliary alphabets, cite the binary cardinality bound, and add 0^0=1 to the multinomial likelihood so boundary-law coverage is a defined assertion.

Demote exact whole-set coverage to a corollary and make its computational companion substantive: specify BH-CERT input encoding, termination/complexity target, and a uniform outer-complex construction over the multinomial confidence region.

Add a worked balanced-channel exhibit computing a nontrivial slice or radial reach of Θ_κ(P*) and use it to benchmark the three-state representation against both the scalar JiangWeiKocaoglu relaxation and generic response-function programs.

recommended_next_step: Repair the two definition-level gaps and recast the tautological coverage proposition as a corollary, then advance the field-grade joint-set kernel to Stage 0.
